title: Oct 1 Results: Perfect Command on the Mound
summary: Oct 1 delivered a clean sheet - 1-0 with 100% accuracy from the pitcher's perspective

content.value:
## A Clean Inning

From a pitcher's perspective, there's nothing better than executing your game plan perfectly. Today we went 1-for-1, hitting our only pick with precision. When you're dealing with a small sample size, every pitch matters - and we located our fastball exactly where we wanted it.

## Breaking Down the Win

The Phillies-Braves matchup was our lone target today. We backed Atlanta at 57% confidence - not a huge edge, but enough to trust our read on the situation. Home field advantage, bullpen depth, and the matchup dynamics all pointed toward the Braves. They delivered.

## The Pitcher's Take

One game, one win. In baseball, you can't ask for better execution than that. Sure, the sample size is small - any pitcher will tell you one good outing doesn't make a season. But when you trust your preparation and it pays off, you take the W and build on it.

The 57% confidence level shows we weren't overcommitting. This wasn't a max-effort fastball - it was a well-spotted two-seamer that got ground ball contact. Smart, calculated, effective.

## Tomorrow's Slate

No games scheduled for October 2nd. Time to review the tape, study the advanced metrics, and get ready for the next series. Even pitchers need a day off to analyze their mechanics and prep for the next start.

We'll be back when the schedule resumes with the same approach: technical analysis, field experience, and picks based on real baseball insight - not gut feelings.
